title: Teal-Style Peep Whistle (3-part)
description: Short, high fipple whistle with a duck-bill-flat mouthpiece, giving a soft peeping, teal-like whistle. Includes lanyard loop on the stopper.
use: Birdwatching / hobby accessory, kids' whistle (adult supervision for small parts).
assembly: 1. Press the fipple plug into the mouth end of the body, flat (windway) side facing the same side as the window.
2. Press the stopper into the far end. Its position sets the pitch (move it in = higher, out = lower; test with a little tape).
3. Blow gently into the mouthpiece notch with your lips sealed around the plug. If it only hisses, check the windway is clear and the plug is fully seated.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
